title: Beetroot, Rice and Goats' Cheese Burgers
changes_from_base: Meat-free: a patty of cooked rice and roasted beetroot bound with a white bean, lemon and egg purée and studded with goats' cheese, browned in the pan then finished in the oven.
summary: Earthy roasted beetroot and creamy goats' cheese bind fluffy rice and white beans into sturdy, satisfying vegetarian patties.

ingredients.item: cooked brown or white rice, cooled
roasted beetroot, finely diced or grated
x 400 g tin white beans, drained and rinsed
fine sea salt or table salt
extra-virgin olive oil or rapeseed oil

steps.title: Purée
steps.text: Purée 1 drained and rinsed 400 g tin white beans with 1 tbsp lemon juice and 1 large egg in a food processor (or mash with a fork).

steps.title: Mix
steps.text: Combine 300 g cooled cooked brown or white rice, 135 g finely diced or grated roasted beetroot and 15 g chopped fresh herbs (parsley and dill); scrape in the bean purée and stir through 57 g crumbled soft goats' cheese, ¾ tsp fine salt and ¼ tsp ground black pepper.

steps.title: Shape
steps.text: With wet hands shape 6 patties and place on a plate.

steps.title: Brown
steps.text: Heat 1 tbsp of 30 ml extra-virgin olive oil or rapeseed oil in an ovenproof frying pan over medium heat and brown 3 of the patties 2 min on one side.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Turn the patties, put the pan in the oven at 190 °C (170 °C fan) for 10 min until 71 °C in the centre, then remove to a plate.

steps.title: Repeat
steps.text: Brown and bake the remaining 3 patties with the rest of the oil.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Place in 6 burger buns with 6 tsp ketchup and your usual toppings, or serve on their own with ketchup.

tips: Let the roasted beetroot cool and pat it dry before mixing it in, so the patties are not wet and hold their shape in the pan.
Mash beans thoroughly so they bind the patties without large chunks.
Chill shaped patties before cooking so they hold together better.
Serve these without buns as a salad base or with yoghurt and chutneys.
storage: Because they contain cooked rice, chill leftover patties quickly and eat within 1 day, reheated until piping hot. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
